description: Starter troubleshooting knowledge base for the Smart Complaint Management Agent. Suggestions are general guidance, not verified diagnoses.

solutions.title: Basic internet connectivity checks
steps: Check whether the router is powered on and its internet indicator shows a normal connection.
Check that network cables are firmly connected.
On the affected device, disconnect from Wi-Fi and reconnect.
If possible, test another device to determine whether the issue affects one device or multiple devices.
If the issue continues, contact the internet service provider and share the troubleshooting steps already attempted.
escalate_when: The router shows a persistent red internet or LOS indicator.
The connection remains unavailable after basic checks.

solutions.title: Slow internet troubleshooting
steps: Run a speed test using a trusted speed-test service.
Move closer to the router and compare the result.
Pause large downloads or streaming on other devices.
Restart the router only if permitted by the service provider.
If speeds remain unusually low, contact the service provider with the speed-test result and time of testing.
escalate_when: Low speeds persist across multiple devices.
The connection repeatedly drops during important activities.

solutions.title: Payment or billing issue
steps: Check the transaction status in the official payment or service application.
Keep the transaction reference number and payment timestamp available.
Check whether the amount is marked as pending, successful, or failed.
Contact the official billing support channel if the status is unclear or the amount is not reconciled.
escalate_when: The amount was debited but the service or order was not updated.
The same payment appears to have been charged more than once.
A promised refund has not arrived within the stated processing period.

solutions.title: Account access assistance
steps: Confirm that the username or registered email address is correct.
Use the official password-reset flow if the password is not accepted.
Check that the device date and time are set correctly if verification codes fail.
Never share passwords, one-time passwords, or recovery codes with anyone.
Contact the official support team if the account remains locked.
escalate_when: The account may have been accessed by someone else.
The official recovery process does not work.
The account is locked after repeated failed attempts.

solutions.title: Delayed service request
steps: Locate the existing service-request or order reference.
Check the latest status through the official service channel.
Record the expected completion date and any previous communication.
Ask the responsible support team for an updated timeline.
escalate_when: The committed service date has passed.
There has been no status update after the stated response window.

solutions.title: General inquiry handling
steps: Identify the exact information the user is requesting.
Provide an answer only when it is supported by an approved information source.
If the required information is unavailable, route the inquiry to the appropriate support team.
escalate_when: The answer depends on account-specific or policy-specific information not present in the knowledge base.
